headline: Wall Street has a new AI giant
summary: Following Anthropic's stock market debut, the market expects OpenAI to follow with a listing by 2027. The article describes Wall Street as having a new AI giant.
why: Anthropic is a leading AI developer, and its listing gives investors direct exposure to frontier AI companies. Listings of major AI firms shape valuations across the sector.
original_headline: Wall Street tiene a un nuevo gigante de la IA
